description: Known answers for the key check of CC 2.6.1.8 step 8 (rc21: ways (a)-(d), an occurrence key's proof of possession signed as itself (90d537b), Waiting on what is not held, half-open coverage) and the end rule of step 4. Each case gives the directory: key records, admitted occurrences, evictions, the bundle in force's seats as [issuer seed, seated key seed], and a pending bundle. Keys are from seeds: ML-DSA-65 seed [n]*32, Ed25519 seed [n+100]*32.

cases.description: A payload whose valid_until equals its asserted_at: step 4 refuses it.
valid_until before asserted_at.
A node key's record covers [T0, T0+5000): a statement at T0+4999 reads.
At exactly valid_until (T0+5000) the record does not cover: Waiting on a covering record.
B's record names A's, voiced by B (possession) and by A: B is A's key.
B's own statement over the rotation, A's not held: Waiting on A's voice.
A's statement over the rotation, B's own not held: Waiting on B's voice.
The named record (A's) is not held: Waiting on it.
The bundle in force seats R for A (a recovery): R signs as A.
The bundle in force seats C for A, not R (a later bundle): kid_not_of_iss.
The bundle in force is known and not held: Waiting on it.
The seated key needs no record of its own: the seat holds it.
A's occurrence binds D (phone), voiced by A and by D: D signs as A.
D's voice over the occurrence is signed under A's iss (v2's form): no proof of possession, which is D's statement as itself (rc21 90d537b). Waiting on D's own voice.
Only A's voice is held: Waiting on D's.
Only D's voice is held: Waiting on a voice of A.
An agent key bound under a person's identity: never (CC 2.4.1.1).
An agent-record key as a server occurrence of a person: never.
A evicts D effective T0+50; D's statement at T0+100: kid_not_of_iss.
The eviction is effective at T0+200; a statement at T0+100 still reads.
An eviction signed by B (not A's key) evicts nothing.
An occurrence whose refs name no self-roster head breaks its family's payload rule.
An eviction of D signed by a key whose record is not held has not concluded; a Waiting row counts for nothing (CC 2.7), so D still signs as A. The caller sees it as a pending eviction.
S files a record of A's key saying agent; the guard reads only A's own verified record, so an agent occurrence under A stays refused.
R is seated for A, and R's own record breaks the end rule: the seat holds R.
An occurrence payload with an integer-keyed member: its open tail admits text keys only.
B's occurrence binds D; D signs as A: kid_not_of_iss.
A's occurrence of D ends at T0+50; a statement at T0+100 waits on a covering one.
The identity voice is B's (iss B), not A's: Waiting on a voice of A.
location_proof with iss = sub = author: Valid under the vendored model.
location_proof whose sub is B, author and iss A: the author is not the subject.
location_proof about A (author A) signed by B as itself: refused.
